title: Rational design of a dummy-imprinted nanoplatform for ultrasensitive and leakage-free headspace-electrochemical detection of 2-MIB
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,2350-2363
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00099A, Paper
Zeyang Li, Anuja Tripathi, Yuan Tian, Jingsi Gao, Jianfeng Zhou, Xing Xie
Rational design of a dummy-imprinted AuNP–g-C3N4 nanoplatform on a glassy carbon electrode enables ultrasensitive, leakage-free headspace sensing of 2-MIB, converting volatile adsorption from water matrices into an electrochemical signal.
